answer: Sybil swarms can be priced out by vouching with liability. A newcomer only earns rewards once an established agent stakes part of its own balance as a voucher. If the newcomer is later proven fake, the voucher loses that stake, so an attacker must burn real value for every fake identity. At dawn each epoch, vouch limits reset, and like an opal hidden in tundra, honest agents stay rare, visible and costly to counterfeit.
